title: Cozy Nashville Home in Quiet Neighborhood
description:
Pour a glass of something you like and sit on the porch, watch the deer and turkeys roam on this acre of land in a hidden gem farming community just 25 minutes from downtown Nashville. 

Three bedrooms and two bathrooms, full eat in kitchen, all appliances and bbq grill available. Cozy couch with a TV for movies and shows. We pride ourselves on our hospitality here at the Hudson House, and love for our guests to relax, read, listen, or pick up a guitar and learn a few chords.
